info.title: Search Tap Affiliate Orders
info.description: TAP can use this API to retrieve a list of affiliate orders and track the affiliate conversions.

post.description: TAP can use this API to retrieve a list of affiliate orders and track the affiliate conversions.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The partner access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 3. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3978f4c20311b8b555) to get partner access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: The default is 20, it must be positive integer, the range is 1-100

parameters.name: category_asset_cipher
parameters.description: The partner identifier used in API requests. Retrieve this value by using the [Get Authorized Category Assets API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/666012dd609d4402cc3be995).

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

create_time_ge.description:
Filter orders to show only those that are created on or after the specified date and time. Unix timestamp.
Please note that we only support 3 months' data at maximum for each single request.
Note:
`create_time_ge` and `create_time_lt` together constitute the creation time filter condition.
`create_time_ge` and `create_time_lt` must be provided together. If both are not specified, data from the last three months will be queried by default.

create_time_lt.description:
Filter orders to show only those that are created before the specified date and time. Unix timestamp.
Refer to notes in `create_time_ge` for more usage information.

campaign_id.description: Filter orders by a TAP campaign using its identifier.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

create_time.description: Time and date of order created, UTC+0 timing

delivery_time.description: Time and date order delivered, UTC+0 timing

settle_status.description:
Settlement Status of the order.
Possible values:
1. "CUSTOMER UNPAID",  customer hasn't paid for the orders.
2. "PENDING", customers can still return or get a refund for this order. The earnings shown are estimates and waiting for settlement.
3. "SETTLED", your earnings have already settled to your account
4. "INELIGIBLE", The order has been returned/refunded/canceled by the buyer, and no commission will be settled.
5. "FROZEN", Possible fraud has been detected regarding the order. The commission will be unfrozen after the fraud is resolved.

amount.description: Price amount for product, such as USD 1000

content_type.description:
The content format of the creator content through which the order was created.
Possible values:
- SHOP
- VIDEO
- LIVE
- PRE_LIVE
- PROMOTION_PAGE
- LINKSHARE
